title: Refund request - returned headphones
lines: Thank you for calling customer support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi. I returned a pair of headphones three weeks ago and I still have not received my refund. This is really frustrating.
I am sorry to hear that, I understand how frustrating it is to wait that long. Can I have your order number please?
It is order four five seven two. I have called twice already and nobody fixed it. I just want my money back.
Thank you. I can see the return arrived at our warehouse, but the refund was never released. I apologize for that.
I have now issued the refund of eighty nine dollars to your card. You will see it within three to five business days.
Oh, that is great news. Thank you, that is a real relief.
You are welcome. I will also email you the refund confirmation. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that is everything. Thanks a lot for sorting this out so quickly.
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day.

title: Where is my order
lines: Good morning, thanks for calling, this is Sam. How can I help?
Hello, I ordered a desk lamp last week and I would like to know where my order is right now.
Of course, I can check that for you. What is the order number?
The order number is eight eight one three.
Thanks. Your package left our warehouse yesterday and it is with the courier now. It should arrive on Thursday.
Perfect, that is good to know. Can I get the tracking link?
Sure, I have just sent the tracking link to your email address.
Great, thank you very much for your help.
You are welcome, enjoy your new lamp.

title: Cancel an order placed by mistake
lines: Hello, thank you for calling, my name is Jordan. What can I do for you?
Hi, I placed an order this morning by mistake and I need to cancel it before it ships. I am a bit worried it is too late.
I understand, let me take a look straight away. Could you give me the order number?
Yes, it is order two zero nine one.
Good news, the order has not been packed yet, so I have cancelled it for you. There is no cancellation fee.
Okay, thank you. That is a relief.
The payment will be returned to your card within two days. Anything else today?

title: Locked out - password reset
lines: Thank you for calling customer support, this is Alex speaking. How can I help you?
I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives. I have tried five times and I am locked out of my account.
I am sorry about that, being locked out is annoying. Let me help you recover your password.
Please do, I need to access my account today and this is getting ridiculous.
I can see the reset emails were going to an old address. I have updated it and sent a new reset link just now.
Okay, I got it. I have set a new password and I am logged in. Thank you so much.
Wonderful. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that is all, thanks for your help.

title: Double charge - escalation
lines: I was charged twice for the same payment on my card and I want this fixed now. This is completely unacceptable.
It is seven seven four zero. I have been a customer for years and this is the worst service I have ever had.
That is not true, my bank statement shows two payments. I want to speak to your manager.
I can raise a ticket with the payments team. They will look at it within seven days.
Seven days? That is ridiculous. I am going to file a complaint.

title: Change the shipping address
lines: Hi, thank you for calling, you are speaking with Sam. How can I help you today?
Hi Sam. I moved house last week and I need to change the shipping address on my order.
No problem at all, I can update the shipping address for you. What is the new address?
It is twelve River Road, Springfield.
Thank you. I have changed the delivery address on your order to twelve River Road.
Brilliant, thank you. That was easy.
Glad I could help. Anything else?
No thanks, have a nice day.

title: Close my account
lines: Good afternoon, thank you for calling, my name is Alex. How can I help?
Hello. I would like to delete my account and remove my personal data please.
I can help with that. May I ask why you want to close the account?
I just do not use the service anymore.
I understand. I have submitted the request to delete your account. You will get a confirmation email within twenty four hours.
Okay, that is fine. Thank you.
Thank you for being a customer. Goodbye.

title: Complaint about a rude courier
lines: Hello, this is Jordan, how can I help?
I want to make a complaint. Your courier was extremely rude to me and threw the parcel at my door.
Okay. What is the order number?
Order five five one two. The box is damaged and nobody seems to care. I am very disappointed.
I will pass the complaint to the delivery team.
Is that it? I expected an apology at least. This is terrible customer service.
The delivery team will contact you.

title: Invoice for a business purchase
lines: Thank you for calling, this is Sam. How may I help you?
Hi, I need an invoice for my last purchase so I can claim it as a business expense.
Certainly. Can I have the email address on the account?
Sure, it is the one ending in office dot com.
Thanks. I have generated the invoice and emailed it to you. It includes the tax details.
Excellent, I can see it in my inbox. Thanks for the quick help.
You are welcome, have a great day.

title: Refund status check
lines: Thank you for calling, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello, I was promised a refund ten days ago and I want to check the status of my refund. I am getting worried.
I understand your concern, let me check the refund status for you right now.
Thank you. The order number is three one one eight.
The refund was processed yesterday. It is on its way to your bank and should appear within two days.
Oh good, that is a relief. Thank you for checking.
Happy to help. Is there anything else?
No, that is all. Thanks again.
